subcommands.description: Updates the settings of query suggestions for an index. Amazon Kendra supports partial updates, so you only need to provide the fields you want to update.

options.name: --index-id
options.description: The identifier of the index with query suggestions you want to update

options.name: --mode
options.description: Set the mode to ENABLED or LEARN_ONLY. By default, Amazon Kendra enables query suggestions. LEARN_ONLY mode allows you to turn off query suggestions.

options.name: --query-log-look-back-window-in-days
options.description: How recent your queries are in your query log time window. The time window is the number of days from current day to past days.

options.name: --include-queries-without-user-information
options.description: TRUE to include queries without user information (i.e. all queries, irrespective of the user), otherwise FALSE to only include queries with user information.

options.name: --no-include-queries-without-user-information
options.description: TRUE to include queries without user information (i.e. all queries, irrespective of the user), otherwise FALSE to only include queries with user information.

options.name: --minimum-number-of-querying-users
options.description: The minimum number of unique users who must search a query in order for the query to be eligible to suggest to your users.

options.name: --minimum-query-count
options.description: The the minimum number of times a query must be searched in order to be eligible to suggest to your users.

options.name: --attribute-suggestions-config
options.description: Configuration information for the document fields/attributes that you want to base query suggestions on
